The client changes the Small and Big Block frequencies immediately after supplying Mission-page copy containing the prior prize figures, requiring the rendered prize copy to change.
Eliminating the Big Block and simplifying its marketing requires Mission-page prize copy to stop advertising that removed mechanism.
The client directs all rendered prize messaging to emphasize one $500 draw per 100-sales block, one ticket per referral, and Chainlink VRF selection.
The source changes referral-validation popup behavior and copy, not Mission-page content.
The source reports missing randomly allocated commissions and tickets; it does not request or entail a Mission-page copy change.
The client accepts a first-mint ticket exception, but neither the acceptance nor its proposal changes Mission-page content.
The exchange concerns a conditional prize-claim button and an unexecuted test plan; it does not establish a Mission-page transparency-copy modification.
